design: Historical clay fixtures, authoring generators and sealed native evidence are unchanged.
The separate pending numeric proposal binds both historical geometry hashes, full state bounds, continuous rotor sweep, preview anchors and proposed triangle/part/texture budgets.
Paint authoring and the optional runtime observation probe require the exact numeric proposal digest; changing it requires an explicit candidate revision.
One opaque 512x512 atlas per kind uses non-overlapping per-face cells with four-pixel gutters; planes and strokes are separate authoring stages with unchanged mesh topology.
Tank uses terracotta and teal; MudMixer uses olive and brass; independent near/far and all-state visual judgment remains pending.
The candidate packaging entrypoint uses the existing M1-c export/codec with ArtPreview authority only; ordinary startup and ReleaseApproved behavior are unchanged.
Existing exact-profile candidate motion and consumer synchronization are reused; new regressions cover both kinds across preview consumers and generation/fallback boundaries.
The optional feedback-only probe observes the actual interactive game without mutating gameplay, save, placement, refinement or resources; observations are not acceptance.
The probe is capped at 1800 samples and 128 entities per category; run separate legs below 170 seconds and disable the probe for performance comparison.
coordinator_entrypoints: Start or resume the primary validation coordinator and storage workflow before executing any validation or heavy work.

tools/blender_ai_workflow/scripts/build_building_m2_candidate.py build Tank --name <fresh-name> --stage planes; repeat with strokes and MudMixer under distinct fresh names via coordinator-owned guarded execution.
build_building_m2_candidate.py verify <kind> --name <name> rechecks source hashes, exported geometry, continuous sweep, atlas pixels, per-face UV and projection reports.

build_building_m2_candidate.py prepare <kind> --name <strokes-name> --generation <generation> --destination <fresh-staging-output> --codec <already-built-codec> produces a private ArtPreview runtime view.

scripts/building_m2_acceptance.py plan --tank-runtime <view> --mixer-runtime <view> --codec <codec> --subject-sha256 <frozen-source-fingerprint> --output <plan> records both-kind consumer/lifecycle and independent gates.

For interactive lifecycle legs, use the native skill guarded launcher with the exact existing HW_BUILDING_ART_SESSION feedback identity and HW_M2_ACCEPTANCE_PROBE=1; do not use the paused building-art-static workload for active acceptance.
The probe writes beside the fresh session status path with .m2-trace.json suffix; scripts/building_m2_acceptance.py inspect inventories observations and always leaves accepted=false.
Capture owned actual windows, renderer/GPU/backend, action outcomes, feet, overlap and near/far judgment with the same frozen subject; the inventory alone proves none of these judgments.
